fields.status_summary: Replay-only benchmark implemented. Analyzer (session-api::delegation_cost) extended with model_distribution, substitutable_shell_count, exploratory_find_ls_count, path_resolution_failures, redispatch_count, and a new compute_delegation_cost_report_from_events() entry point (the two baseline sessions never populated tool-call turns in transcript.json, only in raw events.json, per crate::hook::transcript::handle_message_event). Baseline artifacts checked in under .benchmark/10d21210/: baseline/sessions/{3e9bc20b,41966513}/events.json (raw reference logs) + baseline/delegation_cost_report.json (analyzer output) + README.md (scenario, metric set, determinism statement, thresholds table, replay-only limitation). AC1 met (fixed replay inputs). AC2 met (checked-in event logs + report). AC3 met (all metrics computed by the b7c61f0e analyzer, zero ad-hoc scripting; python used only for read-only inspection during authoring, never for the checked-in numbers). AC4 met: replay is deterministic by construction, run count 1, spread 0 (stated in README). AC5 met: README thresholds table names this benchmark + numeric thresholds for fb14754e AC4/AC5, 66acb737 AC5, 46d8b25d AC5, 77eb143b AC4, cc3324c9 AC5, epic 79c4ac3e AC4. AC6 met: memory-api/crates/session-api/tests/delegation_cost_benchmark.rs::replay_reproduces_checked_in_baseline_report_exactly passes, replaying both checked-in event logs and asserting exact JSON equality with the checked-in report. Limitation documented honestly in README: replay proves determinism, not a genuine before/after drop; no post-change delegation-orchestration session capture existed at implementation time to replay as a provisional data point (current session had no runSubagent spans, so it was not used to fabricate one). Real telemetry: both baseline sessions predate ticket 9d527ad1's token capture, so data_json.usage is absent and all subagent input/output tokens and cost_usd are honestly 0 in this specific baseline (not an analyzer gap). Validation: rtk cargo build -p session-api (pass), rtk cargo test -p session-api (196 passed, 1 ignored generator test), rtk cargo clippy -p session-api --all-targets (0 errors, no new warnings vs baseline). No spec change needed; 7be68a48's analyzer/data-collection contract was extended, not altered.
